connector.name: Wealthville
connector.registryDescription: Solana + EVM liquidity-pool scores: Enter/Hold/Exit verdicts and 0-100 Wealthville Score.
connector.summary: Hosted at wealthville.net over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the amitesh-m account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: WEALTHVILLE_API_KEY
env.description: Optional free partner key for a higher rate limit (anonymous works at 60 req/min)

env.name: WEALTHVILLE_API_URL
env.description: Override the API base URL (default https://wealthville.net)
